title: "Are waits getting better or worse?"
subtitle: "New Zealand hospital waitlists since January 2019, from Health NZ's elective services performance indicators (ESPI)."

::: {#page-national}
:::

::: {.caveat}
These figures count patients **accepted** onto a waitlist. A district that declines more referrals can look better without anyone being seen sooner, so referral processing ([ESPI 1](methods.qmd#espi1)) is shown alongside. The tracker cannot tell you how long you will wait: please talk to your GP or specialist service.
:::
